title: Sokołowska Joanna Halszka
name: Sokołowska Joanna Halszka
description: actress, composer, philosopher, and vocalist. She also creates theatre productions and experimental artistic forms, and has worked as performer, dancer, choreographer, and director. She sings in post-rock band called Przepraszam (Sorry) and is the leader of Der Father ensemble, where she performs together with Daniel Pigoński and Jerzy Rogiewicz. As for her theatre experience, she has performed together with Joanna Piwowar in the piece Wykwalifikowane at the Stage Song Review (OFF Stream) in Wrocław and with Candelaria Saenz Valiente in Asian Candies in Dick Flavor SOS show. She writes mainly choral works, as well as music for film and theatre. In July 2013 her opera In Sarah, Mencken, Christ and Beethoven There Were Men and Women based on the poem by John B. Wolgamot was premiered at Komuna//Warszawa, as part of the Opera//Remix series. Updated: July 2014 (ai)
